raw_text:
Community Event Planning Notes

Event: Neighborhood Cultural Festival | Date: September 2026

Potential Risks

Weather risk: heavy rain could reduce outdoor seating capacity.

Vendor risk: the catering vendor has not confirmed the final delivery time.

Resource risk: only 12 of the required 20 volunteers have confirmed availability.

Equipment risk: the sound system has not completed its final test.

Blockers

Backup indoor venue approval is pending.

Final transport pickup locations are not approved.

Action Items

Coordinator: confirm catering delivery time.

Volunteer lead: recruit 8 volunteers.

Technical lead: test the sound system.

Event manager: obtain indoor-area approval.
